messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — AcmePay just flagged that their org-level latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after the edge release. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/xyz :disappointed:

aditya_support: Thanks Maria. Do we have the org id and the screenshot? Any other dashboards affected or just the org rollup?

maria_cs: Org: acmepay (org_1245). I attached the shot. p50/p90 panels show values, but p95/p99 (the tail lines) are gone on the org view. Service-level panels still show tails for the services they checked.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: edge-release-v2.3.9 by @nora_platform at 2026-03-15T22:12:34Z — note: metrics-transform job v1.8 promoted at 2026-03-15T22:10:00Z

jon_sre: Assigning to eng-sre. @nora_platform can you confirm whether metrics-transform changed metric names or labels in that rollout?

nora_platform: Checking now. We rolled a transform that standardizes collectors: it renames metric name "latency_bucket" -> "request_duration_bucket" and rewrites label names for consistency. Canary looked fine.

jon_sre: That could explain it. Org-level dashboards use the original metric name in the aggregate queries; if the transform renamed series the rollup won't find them. Service-level panels might be using a different selector that still matches. Will validate.

aditya_support: Maria, can you try this quick repro and paste output?

aditya_support: ```
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.95,sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,org))&org=org_1245' | jq .
```

maria_cs: Running it now... result: empty series for latency_bucket when grouped by org. Running with request_duration_bucket returns data and sample buckets.

jon_sre: Confirmed locally: transform renamed the series name and org-level rollups are still querying latency_bucket. Short-term mitigation: update org dashboards to OR across both metric names, e.g.:

jon_sre: ```
sum(rate({__name__=~"(latency_bucket|request_duration_bucket)"}[5m])) by (le,org)
```

nora_platform: Two options: (A) patch dashboards to accept both names (low-risk) or (B) revert the transform promotion and re-run a controlled canary after updating dashboards. If customers need immediate fix, we'll patch dashboards and follow up with a migration note.

maria_cs: I told AcmePay we have a root cause and a temporary dashboard patch option. They prefer not to wait for a revert.

jon_sre: I'll push the dashboard patch to the org-level panels, then verify p95/p99 show up. Also adding a short-term alert to watch for missing percentiles in the next hour.

nora_platform: Noted — we will also add a changelog entry for metrics-transform to notify dashboard owners before renaming metrics.

jon_sre: Patch applied to prod org-level dashboard at 2026-03-15T23:01:12Z. Verified p95/p99 lines returned for acmepay and a couple of other orgs.

maria_cs: Customer (AcmePay) confirmed visuals returned. Thank you all. I'll close the ticket after a final check tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
